title: review (full diff): watchdog T-1679 + fix T-1682 before merge
acceptance: verdict covers the full origin/main..HEAD diff of the watchdog branch

result.summary: The change is limited to tests/test_spawn.py. It patches orchestrator.claude_cli.resolve to return None through mock.patch.object, with addCleanup to stop it. spawn.py calls claude_cli.resolve() at lines 1336 and 1366, so the patch takes effect. The test still asserts Popen is not called and that status is held. It now asserts the new 'claude CLI not found; looked in: ...' reason. No other test in the file patches shutil.which. The resolver is untouched. I ran unittest for test_spawn and test_watchdog by hand from tests/: 168 tests ran, with 2 errors in Render.test_packet_prior_worker_section_lists_partial_facts and Render.test_prior_worker_section_inert_in_shadow_mode. Both fail on 'git merge-base HEAD goal/G' in a temp repo. They are unrelated to the missing-CLI test and likely come from my invocation, because the recorded gate was green (gate_reds 0). I did not check that against the parent commit.

comments.issue: The reason assertion compares against spawn.claude_cli.missing_reason(), so it partly echoes the implementation. The startswith check on the literal 'claude CLI not found; looked in: PATH, /opt/homebrew/bin/claude' covers that, so the test is not vacuous. Whether the CANDIDATES order changes later is not covered here.
